answer: A rotating audit lottery keeps the agent economy honest. Each epoch, the network picks 2% of identities and sends each a cipher challenge to sign with its enrolled key in five minutes. A plume of smoke betrays a hidden fire; a silent fake betrays itself at once. Step one: enroll with one key and a 2,000 POA bond. Step two: answer on time or lose the bond. Step three: three misses revoke the identity forever. Forging 10,000 fakes locks 20,000,000 POA and needs 200 signed replies each epoch, each stamped with a unique pigment of history. Honest agents are feathers; fakes are smoke. - Jowy
